_comment: Timer config for 'Attempt as Mock Test'. Keys match the ids in exams-rrb.json. timerMode 'full' = one composite countdown for the whole paper (all sections share the pool, can move freely between them — this is how almost every RRB CBT actually works). timerMode 'sectional' = the paper is split into timed groups; a group locks and auto-advances to the next group when its own clock hits zero. 'matchSections' are lowercase substrings checked against each parsed section name (same keyword-matching approach score-engine.js already uses for shortSectionName) to sort the real parsed sections into the right timed group at runtime — unmatched sections fall into their own group at 'defaultGroupMinutes'. 'verified' + 'source' record whether this was confirmed against a live search just now or is a reasonable same-family default that should be double-checked against the latest official notification before relying on it for real prep.

rrb-ntpc-ug-cbt1.title: RRB NTPC (Under Graduate) — CBT I
rrb-ntpc-ug-cbt1.source: 100 Q / 90 min composite, explicitly no sectional timing (RRB official pattern, multiple 2026 sources)

rrb-ntpc-ug-cbt2.title: RRB NTPC (Under Graduate) — CBT II
rrb-ntpc-ug-cbt2.source: 120 Q / 90 min composite (same no-sectional rule as CBT I)

rrb-groupd.title: RRB Group D
rrb-groupd.source: 100 Q / 90 min composite, no sectional timing (RRB Group D official 2026 pattern)

rrb-alp-cbt2.title: RRB ALP — CBT II
rrb-alp-cbt2.source: Part A and Part B run back-to-back same day with SEPARATE clocks, not a shared pool: Part A 100 Q / 90 min, Part B (trade) 75 Q / 60 min

rrb-alp-cbt2-parta-only.source: Use this id if your source paper only carries Part A (100 Q, Math/Reasoning/Basic Science & Engineering/GA)

rrb-technician.source: CBT I shared with ALP: 75 Q / 60 min composite. Technician CBT II (Part A only, no CBAT/Part B) duration wasn't confirmed live — verify against the current notification if attempting CBT II specifically.

rrb-paramedical.source: Not confirmed via live search this session — 90 min composite is the standard single-stage RRB CBT default, but check the specific post's official notification before relying on this.
